summary: Steps 4 (iOS) and 5 (web + desktop) done in the worktree, no push/deploy, new logic in new files, flag chat_announcements gates every surface. iOS: new FSMessageAnnouncement.swift (decode-tolerant card model, never-throwing FSLenientAnnouncement wrapper, FSAnnouncementSync, card->FSGroupAnnouncement adapter), FSMessage.announcement (optional, old caches decode), RawMsg.announcement + 7 history construction sites in NetworkService+Messaging pass it; AnnouncementTimelineRow.swift renders the shared AnnouncementWidgetCardBody under an 'Announcement by X / edited' label, tap fetches the full announcement (GroupAnnouncementsService.fetchAnnouncement, no new NetworkService code) and opens read-only GroupAnnouncementDetailView with RSVP/polls; failure shows a warm line, no placeholder; flag-off or card-less lines fall back to the plain system line ('X posted an announcement'). ChatAnnouncementComposer.swift adds the 'Announcement' chip to the + attach row (groups, flag on, not in a thread) opening the existing GroupAnnouncementFormView via a dedicated GroupAnnouncementsViewModel with postsToChat (FSAnnouncementDraft.postToChat sends post_to_chat true on create only). AnnouncementLineMerge.swift + a small hook handle announcement_updated frames (deleted removes the row; updated/restored re-read history and merge only announcement lines; a failed read keeps the cached list). The poster's own server-made line is kept despite the self-echo guard (mine=true). Thin hook-ins only: ChatThreadView.swift (+43 lines: field pass-through at 3 construction sites, frame case, sync token/handler, chip, sheet, env value), MessageGroupRow.swift (+5), MessageGroupRow+SystemLine, MessageAttachments, ComposerAccessorySlot. Web: lib/chatAnnouncements.js (pure helpers), ChatAnnouncementRow.jsx (AnnouncementCardFace + poster/edited meta, tap fetches via new fetchAnnouncement in lib/announcementsApi.js, read-only GroupAnnouncementViewer with RSVP/poll, role=alert error), ChatAnnouncementComposer.jsx (existing GroupAnnouncementForm in a dialog, createAnnouncement with post_to_chat, 403 gate card, failure keeps the form), styles/chatAnnouncements.css; hooks: chatPaging.toMessage, useMessaging (announcement_updated frame, live frame fields, own-line self-echo exception, legacy history map, refreshAnnouncementLines that keeps messages on failure), ChatThread.jsx (+19 lines: row hook, attach-menu item, dialog). Desktop: src-tauri has only lib.rs/main.rs with no announcement, notification or deep-link code and loads the web frontend, so no desktop-specific work; the announcement push is unchanged. Verification: iOS compile-only xcodebuild build (generic iOS Simulator, derived data in the scratchpad, CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO) succeeded after confirming pgrep xcodebuild showed none running; no tests or simulators run. Web: vitest on src/hooks, ChatThread*, src/lib and GroupAnnouncement* = 85 files / 1009 tests pass. vite build cannot run in this worktree because node_modules lacks recharts (AdminActivityMonitoring.jsx), unrelated to this change. No tests written (testing step 6 owns them). Notes for testing: (1) 20261020 title position/size is not in this branch; the row passes title_color/title_font/bg_theme through the shared face so it inherits whatever lands. (2) Live-frame card is viewer-neutral (no group_id/published/can_edit); the iOS adapter fills structural defaults only and the full announcement is re-fetched on tap. (3) File sizes: ChatThreadView.swift 3966->4009, ChatThread.jsx 1815->1834, MessageGroupRow.swift 618->623; all additions are thin hook-ins. (4) docs: no user-visible docs skill run; backend docs were updated in step 1. (5) Restored the tracked frontend/node_modules/.vite results.json that vitest rewrites.
